title: 0 and false for strpos
summary: strpos returns the integer 0 if the substring appears at the beginning, or the Boolean false if not found.
detail: strpos("abc","a") and strpos("abc","z") both behave as false in ordinary if conditions; use strict comparison to distinguish the two return values.
boundary: Return positions are counted in bytes; the displayed column number may differ for multibyte text.
relevance: Explain why the same condition puts initial hits and complete misses into the same branch.
